How to interpret the results

Final viral status represents the final decision of our multi-stage prediction models after evaluating early performance signals at 6h, 12h, and 24h. This helps estimate whether a video is likely to take off, plateau, or decline.

Behavior pattern explains how the viral signals changed over time. Two videos may have the same final label, but their growth pattern can be dramatically different.

Use these two signals together: status = “Explosive Growth” but behavior = “Volatile” means it may go viral — or collapse. Meanwhile, “Consistent” indicates more predictable and reliable growth.
